metricPolicy.stepLosses: Logged every metrics interval from the training batches.
metricPolicy.sdfOutsideRatio: Estimated by sampling candidate 3D points, accepting model-inside points, then checking them against exact EDT SDF constraints.
metricPolicy.projection: Approximate projection IoU/recall/precision from the accepted monitor samples.

references.siren: Sitzmann et al., Implicit Neural Representations with Periodic Activation Functions, NeurIPS 2020.
references.sdfConstraint: SDF validity follows the visual-hull condition max(f_front, f_side, f_top) <= 0.
references.silhouetteMetrics: IoU/precision/recall are standard binary mask overlap metrics used here as 2D supervision consistency.
